data.title: Full Attack
data.subtitle: 2 of 2 swings left this turn
data.description: Attacks with Longsword, one swing after another. Each swing opens the normal attack roll (Normal / Advantage / Disadvantage, or your own dice), and damage follows as usual.
data.footerText: Left-click: attack. Enter rolls Normal in each roll window; tick Quick on the bar above the HUD to roll the rest without windows. Right-click: pick another weapon. Esc on a roll pauses; Esc again stops. Clicking a weapon by hand still works and counts.
